topics.name: Merit Tier Qualification
topics.purpose: Define Tier qualification from explicit Project and recommendation evidence, including the locked minimum of three recommendations and three Projects at the target Tier.

semantics.qualification_rule: Target Tier requires at least 3 qualifying recommendations and 3 qualifying Projects at that Tier.
semantics.project_rule: Qualifying work references distinct canonical Project evidence according to MeritCore policy.
semantics.calculation_rule: Tier is calculated from accepted evidence rather than self-declared.
semantics.review_rule: Negative feedback may trigger review; higher-Tier peers may reduce Tier through explicit review semantics.
semantics.history_rule: Tier changes retain prior evidence/history rather than rewriting the past.
semantics.identity_rule: Tier belongs to one identity and cannot be transferred/merged across identities.

invariants.rule: MeritCore-derived points, Tier, recommendations and trust remain bound to one identity and explicit Project/evidence history; they cannot be manufactured by presentation, identity merging or time-splitting.

hard_gates.condition: Tier granted without required 3 recommendations and 3 Projects
negative review silently rewrites historical evidence
